verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents only adjacent scheduling and automation: payments can be scheduled for a future date (one-off), invoice payment and approval flows can be automated, and card spend limits have reset intervals. None of this shows recurring, user-defined scheduled jobs or workflows. Missing for 10: recurring or repeating payment schedules, a general scheduled-job or workflow builder, API/MCP support for creating schedules, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
